$comment: Regression assertions derived from resolved security-scan findings. Each entry pins the exact policy/grant shape that closed a finding so it cannot silently regress. Run via `bun run security:policies`.

assertions.finding: chatbot_webhooks signing secret exposed to client roles
assertions.mustMatch: REVOKE ALL ON public\.chatbot_webhooks FROM anon

assertions.finding: Any workspace member could read chatbot webhook rows
Avatar objects readable by every authenticated user
assertions.mustMatch: CREATE POLICY "Avatars are readable by owner or co-members" ON storage\.objects[\s\S]{0,900}?workspace_members

assertions.finding: Permissive avatar read policy still present
assertions.mustMatch: DROP POLICY IF EXISTS "Avatars are readable by authenticated" ON storage\.objects

assertions.finding: social_channels OAuth access_token exposed to client roles
assertions.mustMatch: REVOKE ALL ON public\.social_channels FROM anon

assertions.finding: Service-role credentials reachable from the browser bundle
